stepNotes.1: Composition root is createWebAPIs at api/index.ts:12 assembling eight factories; endpoints are re-exported from @openchamber/ui so no route string is duplicated locally.
stepNotes.2: Workspace boundary is the opt-in allowOutsideWorkspace flag forwarded on five files.ts methods; permissions.ts is a deliberate no-op stub that grants no real capability since mutations still hit authenticated server routes.
stepNotes.3: normalizePath plus defensive toDirectoryListResult filtering prevent malformed payloads from breaking the list view; github.ts builds query strings three different ways (URLSearchParams, manual encodeURIComponent concat, new URL+searchParams.set) which is a latent encoding hazard.
stepNotes.4: No secrets are handled client-side; GitHub tokens stay server-side and only the short-lived deviceCode is sent in authComplete; downloadFile builds an encoded anchor href with no injection surface.
stepNotes.5: Layer is stateless with fresh factory objects; terminal.ts delegates reconnect to @openchamber/ui/terminalApi with tunable retry from constants.ts; tools.getAvailableTools refetches per call with no memoization.
stepNotes.6: git.ts is an interface-satisfying passthrough whose worktree namespace re-aliases already-flat functions by interface design; the real duplication is the eight repeated fetch-error blocks in files.ts and the duplicated Window global declaration across main.tsx and mini-chat-main.tsx.
stepNotes.7: No silent empty catches on production paths; jsonOrNull and the .catch fallbacks feed the following throw; notifications.ts logs denial/unsupported/failure via console with no telemetry; only opaque value is the "invalid" sentinel in tools.ts:21.
stepNotes.8: Ran co-located vitest (files/git/notifications .test.ts) from desktop/packages/web: 3 files, 6 tests passed; coverage is thin with only 2 of 10 files.ts methods and zero github.ts methods exercised; findings/ is empty so no prior items exist.
stepNotes.9: Static read-only review of desktop-web-src with no source changes; no Critical findings so reverify.md is not written; verifier codex-sol should independently confirm github.ts query-building consistency and the coverage gaps.
